title: Playboy September 2008 Anna Faris Guns N' Roses Complete w/ Centerfold
conditionDescription: Complete w/ centerfold. Covers clean and bright with light handling wear; spine intact. See photos.
descriptionText:
Playboy magazine, September 2008. Original $5.99 cover price. Complete w/ Centerfold.

Cover features: Anna Faris is The House Bunny - 20Q; the voluptuous Keeley Hazell; Beauty and the Geek winner; Hair metal, Hollywood and heroin - the rise of Guns N' Roses (exclusive excerpt); UFC's Dana White interview; Denis Johnson's Nobody Move Part III; college football roundup.

Back cover: Ketel One vodka ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
